Bridge request preflight/dry-run state behavior is covered by the native bridge tests.
Catalog parsing, safety and apply behavior moved to internal/catalog.
User lifecycle and identity behavior moved to internal/users.
Human CLI parsing/dispatch moved to internal/cli.
Transfer CLI dispatch is covered by CLI and service tests.
Static/dynamic completion is native Go and contract-backed.
Configuration defaults, migration and normalization moved to internal/config.
Controller mount/session orchestration moved to internal/controller.
Python↔Go SQLite round-trip became native SQLite compatibility tests and frozen persistence contracts.
Generic backend/runtime identity is covered by contract and module tests.
Standalone Android companion runtime/resolver tests were explicitly retired in WR12; protocol-v1 and root-module WebUI compatibility are covered by Go bridge/module retirement seals.
Go-native build/release tooling is covered by internal/repoctl.
Frozen migration contracts are decoded and validated in Go.
Host/daemon clipboard behavior moved to internal/clipboard.
Install service orchestration is covered by service and installer tests.
Distro installers moved to native Go packages.
Interactive process/session behavior moved to system and CLI tests.
Module tree/render/integrity behavior moved to internal/module.
Source/module/release tooling moved from manage_source.py to repoctl.
Module boot/runtime status is covered by module/service tests.
Native module runtime sealing moved to Go module/repo tooling.
Android Go runtime identity/sealing moved to Go.
Runtime update/readiness behavior is covered by module/services.
Output/model presentation helpers moved to Go.

Registry schema/CRUD/transactions moved to Go.
Registry repair is covered by registry/service tests.
Release identity/runtime/module parity is enforced by Go contracts and repo tooling.
Runtime chroot operations are service/controller behavior.
Runtime clipboard behavior moved to Go clipboard/services.
Runtime command dispatch/execution moved to CLI/system.
Preview/confirmation lifecycle moved to bridge/operations.
Runtime installation behavior moved to installer/services.
Standalone Android companion coverage was explicitly retired by WR12 after root-module WebUI parity; the WR12 retirement contract prevents the obsolete product path from returning.
Session lifecycle moved to controller/system.
Service-unit lifecycle moved to the Go service layer.
Runtime user operations moved to users/services.
Transport-neutral backend service layer is native Go.
Low-level system/process/root/mount behavior moved to Go.
UID/GID synchronization moved to internal/users.
